messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I had an awesome anesthesiologist who talked to me through every step and kinda eased my fears about the giant needle going into my back.

output.original_text: I had an awesome anesthesiologist who talked to me through every step and kinda eased my fears about the giant needle going into my back.
output.joy: I had an amazing anesthesiologist who chatted with me throughout every step and completely soothed my worries about the giant needle going into my back!
output.sadness: I had an anesthesiologist who tried to talk to me through every step but I still felt uneasy about the giant needle going into my back.
output.fear: I had an anesthesiologist who talked to me through every step, which helped a bit with my overwhelming fear of the giant needle going into my back.
output.anger: I had an anesthesiologist who talked me through each step, but I couldn’t shake my anger about that giant needle going into my back.
output.surprise: I had an anesthesiologist who surprisingly talked to me through every step, easing my anxiety about the giant needle going into my back.
output.disgust: I had an anesthesiologist who talked through every step, trying to ease my disgust at the thought of that giant needle going into my back.
